hypotheses.paper: M* globally hyperbolic Cauchy-complete E-maximal, anabelian pi_1 (l.1149)
hypotheses.note: through GX.E0AbsMax.cor_abs_max_C1 (Reg M GH + Cauchy-complete), GX.e0RegM_holonomy (rho faithful, torsion-free, loxodromic) and Causal.Flat.ccAction_of_developsCC; anabelian read as pi_1(Reg M) not metabelian, as before
formerly the one tagged sorry; now proved from lean-causal's Barbot (DEC-34), no new external, no axiom

findings: BTZ_1.tex l.1149 cites Barbot for « rho_L discrete and faithful ». In lean-causal, Barbot's route goes through family (b) (loxo_generic_centralExtension). Its group is the restriction Gamma'_U to the maximal unipotent subspace U, not Gamma' (its docstring: « The family-(b) group of M1 is the restriction Gamma'_U »). So that route does not give the statement directly. It is proved here by a different route, which uses that pi_1 is not metabelian in place of the classification: (i) ker L on rho(pi_1) is trivial, since otherwise E = span(ker L translations) is a spacelike line R e fixed by a power of a loxodromic, every L(gamma) maps e to ±e, and rho(pi_1) is metabelian; (ii) the same argument with Causal.Flat.Lox.fix_second_null shows rho(pi_1) nonelementary; (iii) U = M^3, since a Gamma-invariant timelike line contradicts the loxodromic and a timelike plane makes Gamma metabelian; then bprop_LU_discrete applied to Gamma itself gives L(Gamma) discrete up to conjugation by an isometry of M^3.

No correction to the paper's statement: l.1149 is true as cited, under the section's standing hypotheses (E_0, pi_1 not metabelian standing for 2g-2+s>0). The row stays partial only on the pre-existing SCOPE items of Admissible.lean: (b) E_0 only (T-btz-scope) and (d) the marking is a hypothesis (T-btz-headline-repr).
questions: None new. The reading « anabelian fundamental group » = « pi_1(Reg M) not metabelian » (hnm) is the one Admissible.lean and the strict GX.e0RegM_holonomy already took; this proof uses exactly that hypothesis (and needs no more: nonelementarity is derived, not assumed).

kb_proposals: Barbot in 2+1 for a holonomy group: GX.BTZAdm.linearPart_comp_faithful_discrete (CCAction + loxodromic + not metabelian + torsion-free => L∘rho faithful with discrete image); do not route through loxo_generic_centralExtension, whose family-(b) group is Gamma'_U.

The metabelian criterion GX.BTZAdm.isMetabelianOn_of_sign: if every L(gamma) maps the unit spacelike vector e of a null frame to ±e (and translations orthogonal to e are trivial), Gamma <= Isom(M^3) is metabelian. It kills the kernel of L, the elementary case, and a Gamma-invariant timelike plane alike.

Stabilizer of a spacelike vector in SO_0(1,2) is abelian (GX.BTZAdm.frame_commute_of_fix); the swap of the two null lines is excluded by a det computation in the null-frame basis (rw [<- LinearMap.det_toMatrix F.basis, Matrix.det_fin_three]; simp only [F.toMatrix_apply, frameCoord, Matrix.cons_val_*]).
